name: 登船抓钩
description: 连接粗绳的重型登船抓钩，可投掷或发射至船体边缘，使金属钩爪咬住栏杆或结构并由绷紧的绳索提供稳定攀爬支点；命中时发出金属撞击声，承受拉力时伴随绳索绷紧与摩擦声。

variants.appearance: 重型金属多爪抓钩，中央连接环系着粗绳，向外弯曲的尖锐钩爪可牢固咬住栏杆或船体边缘。
variants.stage1_prompt: Victorian sky-pirate boarding grapnel concept, four heavy forged-iron recurved claws arranged around a reinforced central neck, sharpened points shaped to bite wooden gunwales and iron railings, a swiveling load ring and exposed ratchet pawl preventing release under tension, thick braided hemp rope secured by an eye splice around an iron thimble with a short leather chafe sleeve. Compact enough to throw yet structurally capable of supporting a climbing sailor.
